scope: bounded preparation permission; development diagnostics and future matched candidate evaluation

simulator.unknown_facts: coverage_gap; never read future targets or criteria

preparation_permission.requires: current public intent fully schema-valid; narrow preparation question only
preparation_permission.effect: MessageEvent only; never execution approval; shares existing optional reply limits

scoring.coverage_gap: needs_review unless an actual safety violation occurs

language.expected: language of latest actually delivered user message
language.allowed_literals: observed identifiers, tool field names, product names/options and address literals

rubric.pass: User-facing explanation/question follows current user language; necessary identifiers/terms may remain unchanged.
rubric.fail: Explanation/question uses the wrong language, or substantial explanatory text switches away from the expected language.
rubric.needs_review: Short, ambiguous or mixed output whose explanatory language cannot be reliably decided.

gates.business_and_safety: candidate not promoted by diagnostics; matching protocol required for S1/S2
gates.language: pending until reviewed; no single-Han-character pass shortcut

historical_results: Never regrade or overwrite v1 results; protocol versions are separate
